title: target.json
description: One benchmark target: a merged pull request pinned by revision, with its frozen packet, provisioning identity, and exposure history. Registers live beside it as register.v<N>.json.

base_sha.description: The pull request's recorded base; kept separate from the computed merge-base.

base_ref_name.description: Upstream base branch name, a fact about the pull request.

local_base_branch.description: Every mirror names the base main because the Claude built-in diffs main...HEAD.

diff_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sorted changed-file list with per-file base and head blob ids, so a rebuilt mirror is checked against the frozen diff identity.

legacy_packet_sha256.description: Hash of a preserved packet.legacy.md from an earlier grid, when one exists.

recipe.description: Commands run after clone from the offline cache, or 'none'.

allowance.description: The focused-command allowance text given identically to every arm.

platform.description: Toolchain and OS record at freeze, e.g. 'Linux 6.6 x86_64; Python 3.14.7; node 24.19.0'.

cache.description: The executable form of the recipe, run by provision.py. Commands go through sh -c with {cache}, {clone}, {work} and {cache_root} substituted.

build.description: Run once, online, in a scratch clone at the head, to populate {cache}; the cache directory is then archived and hashed.

post_clone.description: Run offline in every attempt clone after cloning; must leave the tracked tree clean.

used_by.description: Runs, grids, and skill-development work that used this target.
